FN-P6KZGG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 195
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/27/2023
House Bill 195 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Real Estate
Commission until October 1, 2024 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
